programs.title: Gold Rush Maisie
programs.desc: Maisie hears about a gold rush just outside a town, and decides to go into business with a family of poor prospectors and a crotchety ranch owner who may be unknowingly sitting on a valuable vein of gold.

programs.title: Maisie Gets Her Man
programs.desc: Maisie (Ann Sothern) falls on hard times and works at several odd jobs before she meets aspiring comedian Hap (Red Skelton).

programs.title: The Barbarian
programs.desc: An Egyptian-American woman (Myrna Loy) runs around Cairo with a desert charmer (Ramon Novarro) who turns out to be a prince.

programs.title: When Ladies Meet
programs.desc: The wife (Ann Harding) of a publisher meets his girlfriend (Myrna Loy), who does not know he's married.

programs.title: Penthouse
programs.desc: A gangster, his lawyer (Warner Baxter) and an underworld mistress (Myrna Loy) topple a rival gangster together.

programs.title: Night Flight
programs.desc: Pilots risk their lives by flying in dangerous weather through the Andes Mountains to deliver medicine to Rio de Janeiro.

programs.title: The Prizefighter and the Lady
programs.desc: Inspired by a gangster's girlfriend (Myrna Loy), a heavyweight contender (Max Baer) takes on the champ (Primo Carnera).

programs.title: Men in White
programs.desc: A socialite (Myrna Loy) lures a young surgeon (Clark Gable) away from his mentor (Jean Hersholt) and research work.

programs.title: Stamboul Quest
programs.desc: A U.S. medical student (George Brent) falls for a German spy (Myrna Loy) and follows her to World War I Turkey.

programs.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programs.desc: A disabled serviceman and two other veterans (Fredric March, Dana Andrews) have difficulty adjusting to civilian life after World War II.

programs.title: The Red Pony
programs.desc: A lonely boy (Peter Miles) and his father's ranch hand (Robert Mitchum) work together to raise a chestnut pony.

programs.title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
programs.desc: A New York adman (Cary Grant) and his calm wife (Myrna Loy) buy a big old fixer-upper in rural Connecticut.

programs.title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
programs.desc: A judge (Myrna Loy) orders a playboy (Cary Grant) to date her infatuated teenage sister (Shirley Temple) to cure the girl's crush on him.

programs.title: Third Finger, Left Hand
programs.desc: An artist (Melvyn Douglas) moves in with a magazine editor (Myrna Loy) whose job depends on the pretense of a husband.

programs.title: So Goes My Love
programs.desc: Eccentric British inventor Hiram Maxim (Don Ameche) and his bride (Myrna Loy) raise a son (Bobby Driscoll) in late-1800s Brooklyn.

programs.title: A Successful Calamity
programs.desc: A financier (George Arliss) comes home and tells his wife (Mary Astor), son and daughter (Evalyn Knapp) he is broke to get their attention.

programs.title: Turn Back the Clock
programs.desc: A cigar-store keeper (Lee Tracy) dreams of what his life would have been like with power, prestige and a rich wife.

programs.title: The Millionaire
programs.desc: An incognito auto tycoon (George Arliss) works at a gas station with a student (David Manners) who loves the tycoon's daughter (Evalyn Knapp).

programs.title: Tycoon
programs.desc: An engineer (John Wayne) woos the daughter (Laraine Day) of a tycoon (Cedric Hardwicke) who has hired him to build a railroad in the Andes.

programs.title: Silver Dollar
programs.desc: A farmer (Edward G. Robinson) strikes Colorado silver, enters politics and leaves his wife (Aline MacMahon) for a blonde (Bebe Daniels).

programs.title: The World Changes
programs.desc: A young Midwesterner (Paul Muni) becomes a meat tycoon with a socialite wife (Mary Astor).

programs.title: Boom Town
programs.desc: Texas wildcatters (Clark Gable, Spencer Tracy) hit oil together, then fight after one marries the other's sweetheart (Claudette Colbert).

programs.title: The Enchanted Cottage
programs.desc: A disfigured veteran (Robert Young) and his homely bride (Dorothy McGuire) look beautiful to each other in a seaside cottage.

programs.title: Desire Me
programs.desc: A Frenchwoman's (Greer Garson) husband (Robert Mitchum), thought to be dead, returns from war and finds her in love with one (Richard Hart) of his comrades.

programs.title: The Great Lie
programs.desc: A lost aviator's (George Brent) socialite wife (Bette Davis) makes a deal with a pianist (Mary Astor) having his baby.

programs.title: Random Harvest
programs.desc: An amnesiac World War I British veteran (Ronald Colman) marries a chorus girl (Greer Garson), then forgets her.

programs.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
programs.desc: A young Englishwoman (Wendy Hiller) aims to marry a tycoon but finds love with a naval officer (Roger Livesey) instead.

programs.title: Dark Victory
programs.desc: An heiress (Bette Davis) with only months to live embarks on a social whirl, then marries her doctor (George Brent).
